root_cause: ResourceAdmissionDenied stack identifies charged OwnedVector image copying into integrity scannedPages. That map retained full LargeValue DATA/MANIFEST images although later checks use decoded headers/manifests. Its separate data map also retained unneeded uncharged payload vectors.
fix: Authenticate every visited page with the same codec/owner/CRC checks, retain only identity/visibility records and decoded manifests for LargeValue pages, and fixed-size data identity/range fields. Other typed page images and all later cross-structure/orphan/content-index checks remain.
